scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Developer app and bot token; server authorization and privileged-intent approval may limit scope.
app.surface: REST + Gateway; guilds, channels, messages and interactions
app.note: Build around bot permissions; do not treat a user login session as a bot API credential.
app.next_action: Create a test bot, verify developer-account eligibility and grant it access to one test guild and channel.
app.success_criterion: Read bot-visible metadata and demonstrate denial for an ungranted channel.
app.alternative_action: Use the bot API and Gateway as appropriate; do not reverse engineer a personal user session into a self-bot.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
